# Vendor Onboarding

<figure><img src="../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (4).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The Vendor Addition or Onboarding functionality in CorpCash enables an authorized administrator to register a new vendor within the platform and establish the vendor's basic business, contact, banking, tax, and service-category information. The onboarding process ensures that the vendor record is created with the information required for subsequent vendor-related operations, including wallet transactions, settlements, and applicable payout activities.

The vendor onboarding process can be initiated from the Vendors module. When no vendor records are available, the system displays an empty-state message indicating “No vendors yet”, along with the option to “Add your first vendor.” Once vendor records are available, administrators can initiate the onboarding process using the Add Vendor option available on the Vendors page.

Once administrator click on “Add Your First Vendor” in the center or “Add Vendor” upper right corner of the dashboard it will redirect them to new window where administrator must provide the details of Vendor as shown in the image below.

Once mandatory information ais being filled click on “Submit” for the further process where an email will be triggered to the vendors registered E-mail address.



{% stepper %}
{% step %}
### Open the Vendors Module

Log in to the CorpCash application using authorized administrator credentials. From the left-side navigation menu, select **Vendors** to open the Vendors module.

<figure><img src="../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (5).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### Initiate Vendor Onboarding



<figure><img src="../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (4).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

If no vendor records are available, the system displays the empty-state message “No vendors yet” along with the “Add your first vendor” option.

Administrators can initiate the vendor onboarding process by selecting either:

* “Add your first vendor” from the center of the Vendors page when no vendor records are available.
* “Add Vendor” from the upper-right corner of the Vendors page when vendor records are already available.
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### Enter Vendor Details

<figure><img src="../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (6).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

After selecting “Add your first vendor” or “Add Vendor,” the system navigates to the Add Vendor page.

Enter the required vendor information in the respective fields, including the vendor’s identification, contact, banking, and category details, as displayed on the page.

Ensure that all mandatory fields are completed before proceeding.
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### Submit Vendor Information

<figure><img src="../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (7).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

After entering and reviewing all mandatory vendor information, click **“Submit”** to initiate the vendor onboarding process.

The system validates the submitted information and, if the submission is successful, creates the vendor onboarding request.
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### Vendor Invitation Email

Following successful submission, the system triggers an email to the vendor’s registered email address.

The email enables the vendor to proceed with the applicable onboarding or account activation process.
{% endstep %}
{% endstepper %}
